reviewContext.issueReference: local:feat/ai-capture#ai-capture-M23-M16 (no GitHub issue); opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-884, continuing sessions 868 and 883; source of truth is the workflow requestedOutcome, design-docs/specs/design-ai-capture.md revision 5 (CAP-R5-01 to CAP-R5-04) and impl-plans/active/capture-23-wiring.md, capture-16-docs-final.md (revision 6)
reviewContext.userProblem: Finish the nodetto AI capture feature on feat/ai-capture so an AI agent can capture any page as PNG or JPG, and a 3D CAD page from a chosen camera with interference visible as a hatched overlay and reported as text. HEAD e43016d is a partial, unaccepted M23 checkpoint: cargo test -p nodetto-capture fails three render.rs tests, and admission, tile-major storage, liveness spans, the scan allowance and most of the M23 test inventory are missing. M16 remains.
requiredOutcomes: M23: the picture pass uses tool_view with one first-tool classification computed in setup, admission before allocation (exact work, entry limit 4,194,304, tile-major storage), O(1) liveness spans, an in-fold boundary-scan allowance of 16e9 with bounded overshoot, overlay and hatch agreeing with the text, a 45% reference mix and the census (24M budget when interference is off). render.rs is fixed under CAP-R5-01 and CAP-R5-03. The CLI and desktop wiring follow design 4.1, 4.2, 12 and CAP-R4-07. All crate, CLI, desktop and native parity tests pass.

M16: docs/capture.md and docs/cli.md let an agent discover capture unprompted; measured budgets and deviations are recorded in the design; the overview progress table marks every milestone accepted; all three final gates exit 0 with logs and native parity evidence.
Existing export behavior and documents keep working; captures stay deterministic; all commits are local on feat/ai-capture.
nonGoals: Redoing accepted milestones M1 to M15, M17 to M20 and M22.
cad3d M21 and cad3d M18; edits of cad3d design or plan files; README.md edits.
Design sections 2.3 and 2.4; any nodetto-cloud, server, auth, secret or deployment code.

Edits of census.rs, lattice.rs, interference.rs, interval.rs, overlay.rs, prism.rs, scene.rs, tests/interference.rs, apps/cli/native/src/engine_tests.rs or the TypeScript capture core (except the fixture expectations of cad-request.test.ts).
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths and their own plan file Progress section. No git state changes, no stash, branches or worktrees; never push.
English only, no emojis, strict TypeScript without any; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/capture-<mNN>; format only owned files.
crates/capture: forbid(unsafe_code), no panic on any input, only + - * / and sqrt on geometry, dependencies only png and jpeg-encoder. Heavy or timed tests are release only.
Existing tests and deadlines are never weakened except the pre-authorized M23 changes (a) to (e) of its plan; timing tests may be retried up to three attempts, then run in isolation, all logged.
Theme tokens only; own fixtures with neutral names; no new dependency.
Per-edit fresh reads and git hash-object before and after each owned file; drift is recorded, not overwritten.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R5-04: one wiring plan followed by M16 (no wiring split).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The remaining crate work all meets in raster.rs, and the native parity gate needs crate and CLI together; a split would leave parity failures without a write owner. Step 3 accepted this.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R5-01: render.rs:162-178 becomes [Drawn, Drawn, Drawn, Hidden, Outside, Empty] with emptied_by_step -1 and 1 for the last two bodies; no code change to restore Absent.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Design 6.3 and 6.7: absent is a pre-census value; reported states are drawn, hidden, outside, empty, unknown.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R5-03: the render.rs digest 0x29c6_4b3e_156d_0941 is replaced only after tests/overlay.rs shows the bit-clear plate-iso render keeps it, changed pixels lie in a reported pair's projected box widened by 2 px, and both hatch colours appear.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: plate-iso.ncs1 has options 3, 7 tools, 3 bodies and no reference or mesh body, so only the hatch may change pixels.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R5-02: draw and analyse bits act separately in the crate; capture-plate-default.ncs1 holds the options-3 bytes, capture-plate-no-interference.ncs1 the options-0 bytes; M23 owns the fixture expectations of cad-request.test.ts.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Ratifies the session 883 amendment; tests/interference.rs:217-241 and engine_tests.rs pass unedited.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R4-07 to CAP-R4-10 unchanged: M23 owns tmp/capture and the optional interference option of captureCadImage; tiles.rs admission and tile-major storage; first-tool classification and the 24M census budget; O(1) liveness spans and the 16e9 boundary-scan allowance.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Accepted in revision 4; still the remaining contract.

intentionalTradeoffs: M23 replaces the render.rs digest and the four superseded assertions (three of design 8.5 and the CAP-R5-01 state assertion), and updates the M9 [not in the picture] expectation, exactly as the design authorizes; commit messages state old and new values.
M16 gates may hit the Foundation atomic-write denials recorded at M10 (exit 101); these stay failures and are retried and logged, never counted as passing.
supportedEdgeCases: Open first tool: surface only, no census, no pairs, open true. Later open operand: union and difference unchanged, intersection empties; open false.
Scenes above the work, entry or boundary-scan limits are refused with exit 2 and fixed messages, identically for every worker count.
--no-interference still reports emptied bodies (24M census budget).
Desktop interference absent means DEFAULT_CAD_INTERFERENCE (options 3); null means options 0.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Perspective projection, wireframe capture and PCB board tool behavior (cad3d M18, M21).
Cloud document capture and server-side rendering (design 14).

acceptanceCriteria: Picture, report (open), census and interference eligibility use one first-tool classification computed once per tool in setup; no is_solid or is_closed call runs per sample; a later open operand keeps material for union and difference and empties it for intersection; open-source bodies get no census error and no pair (design 6.7, CAP-R4-09).

Scenes are admitted before allocation (admit().work equals TileLists::work, entry limit 4,194,304) with tile-major storage and per-tile body visits; liveness costs O(1) per listed step; boundary reads are checked inside the fold with at most allowance + workers x 1,048,576 executed reads; refusals exit 2 with the fixed messages, identically for 1, 2 and 5 workers (design 10.2, CAP-R4-08, CAP-R4-10).

The census uses a 24M ray budget when interference is off; no reported body has state absent (CAP-R5-01); overlay marks agree with the report text; reference bodies mix at 45%; JSON keys unchanged; bytes equal across thread counts.

render.rs: the CAP-R5-01 assertion and the three design 8.5 assertions are replaced as specified; the digest constant is replaced only after the CAP-R5-03 overlay checks pass (bit-clear plate-iso keeps 0x29c6_4b3e_156d_0941), with old and new values in the commit message.

nodetto-cli capture accepts the interference options for CAD pages only, prints the body line, errors and interference lines, adds the JSON forms and uses interferenceExitCode; captureCadImage accepts interference: null (options 0) and defaults to options 3; capture-plate-default.ncs1 holds options 3 and capture-plate-no-interference.ncs1 options 0.

Every test listed in the plan's Tests section and every case of design 8.5 'M23 acceptance additions' passes, including the exact 53,692,800-read count and the costly-row refusal with 1, 2 and 5 started workers; the 20,000-intersection, 200,000-triangle and M9 deadlines pass unchanged; tests/interference.rs and engine_tests.rs are unedited; native parity passes with no skip.
